prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1062; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the file.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's alright. You already have it on the claim.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection in League City, Texas. It was a four-way intersection with traffic lights.

Q: What direction were you traveling, and what was the signal showing for you?

A: I was heading east. My light was green, I'm pretty sure of that. I had just started to move again after the cars in front of me cleared.

Q: What happened next?

A: A car coming from the north side ran through the intersection and hit the driver's side of my vehicle. I didn't see it coming at all. I braked, but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My neck hurt right away, and by the next morning it was stiff and sore. I have a headache from time to time, and turning my head to check mirrors is painful. I went to a clinic the following day.

Q: Did you need any emergency treatment at the scene?

A: No, I was able to get out of the car on my own. The paramedics checked me over and I declined transport at that point.

Q: Have you had any previous neck problems?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago after a long drive, but it cleared up on its own and I didn't see a doctor about it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'd like the other driver's side of this to be looked at carefully. That's all I have to say.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
